entry: Viewing Sarah Chen > Wednesday 24 June > existing Unspecified 1.25h block

recommendations.title: Keep the editor on screen
recommendations.issue: Save and Cancel sit below the viewport at both 1440 x 1000 and 1133 x 1000. The measured panel is 416px high; positioning reserves only 360px.
recommendations.recommendation: Place the editor using its actual size. Open above the time block when there is more room, clamp it below the global header, and update its position when the workspace scrolls or resizes.
recommendations.tradeoff: The editor can change side relative to its block. Preserve a small visual gap and the existing block context rather than introducing a full-screen dialog.

recommendations.title: Protect the header and action row
recommendations.issue: The entire panel currently has one unbounded height. Enlarging Note or adding validation can push the actions further off screen. The framed Close also competes with the form fields.
recommendations.recommendation: Keep project identity and a quiet DS Close control in the header. Keep Delete on the left and Cancel / Save on the right in a visible footer. Let only the fields scroll when space is constrained, retaining the existing field sizing, labels and Brisk styling.
recommendations.classification: Observed layout limitation plus design refinement
recommendations.tradeoff: A short desktop may need a little internal scrolling. This preserves readable controls and reachable actions without making the editor wider. Do not replace this specialised editor with the Columns settings popover.

recommendations.title: Make valid hours obvious
recommendations.issue: With Hours set to 0, the native field reports invalid, but Save stays enabled and there is no inline explanation. Source code would silently clamp and round the submitted number; that invalid save was not executed.
recommendations.recommendation: Show a quiet hint: “0.25-24 hours, in 0.25-hour steps.” Allow temporary incomplete typing. Show a concise error after interaction when needed and disable Save until the value is valid. Never silently change the hours on Save.
recommendations.classification: Observed field state; save outcome supported by source
recommendations.tradeoff: Explicit validation asks the user to correct an invalid value. It is clearer than silently converting it. Keep the existing quarter-hour precision and 24-hour maximum; no new time policy.

recommendations.title: Make keyboard entry and exit predictable
recommendations.issue: Enter opens the editor while focus remains on its time block. Escape from Hours leaves the editor open. Close and Cancel leave focus on the page body. The Stage list correctly consumes its own Escape.
recommendations.recommendation: On keyboard opening, move focus to Stage. Let the Stage list handle Escape first; a subsequent Escape cancels the editor and returns focus to the original time block. Close and Cancel also return focus. Preserve non-modal access to the board and the existing explicit Save boundary.
recommendations.classification: Observed behaviour plus proposed interaction refinement
recommendations.tradeoff: Escape discards the local draft, matching Cancel. Keep that meaning explicit. Do not add autosave, a focus trap or the Media comment confirmation flow to this small editor.
